Saving YouTube Videos to Your iPhone

Whether you're traveling, commuting, or just want to save data, downloading YouTube videos to your iPhone is incredibly useful. In 2026, the process is simpler than ever with MediaGrabber.

Step 1: Get the Video Link

Open the YouTube app on your iPhone. Find the video you want, tap the "Share" icon, and select "Copy Link".

Step 2: Use MediaGrabber in Safari

Open Safari and go to MediaGrabber. Paste the link you just copied into the search bar. Our tool will instantly process the video and provide download options.

Step 3: Download and Save to Files

Tap "Download Video". Safari will ask if you want to download the file. Tap "Download". Once finished, tap the Downloads icon next to the address bar, open the video, tap the share sheet, and choose "Save Video" to move it to your Photos app!

The Next Generation of iPhone

The iPhone 18 Pro Max is expected to be one of the most advanced smartphones ever released. With major improvements in design, performance, and artificial intelligence, this upcoming device from Apple could redefine what users expect from a premium phone.

A Completely Redesigned Display

Apple is reportedly working on a fully immersive display experience. The iPhone 18 Pro Max could feature an edge-to-edge screen with no visible notch or cutout.

Powerful Performance Upgrade

The device is expected to include a next-generation chip, possibly built on a 2nm process. This would result in faster processing speeds, improved graphics performance, and better energy efficiency.

Smarter AI Integration

Artificial intelligence will play a bigger role than ever. From smarter voice assistance to real-time suggestions and automation, the iPhone 18 Pro Max could become a more intuitive personal assistant.

Camera Improvements for Creators

Photography and video capabilities are expected to improve significantly. Rumors suggest a more advanced main sensor, enhanced zoom capabilities, and improved low-light performance.

Expected Price Range

The iPhone 18 Pro Max is expected to remain in the premium segment, with a price range estimated between 1400€ and 1800€.

Release Date

Apple typically announces new iPhones in September, so the iPhone 18 Pro Max is expected to be revealed in September 2026.
